rationale: The plan fits a single ~condition model on all twelve samples, answers the omnibus question with a DESeq2 LRT against ~1 and the pairwise question with named Wald contrasts against an explicitly relevelled control, keeping the two questions distinct and BH-adjusted within each contrast — exactly the reference design; the edgeR QL cross-check matches the same design and filter. QC (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, coloured by condition with an explicit note that there is no batch variable) precedes the model with a flag-only outlier policy appropriate to n=4. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, normalization stays inside the model (median-of-ratios and TMM, no pre-normalized input), and ashr shrinkage is chosen with a correct rationale given the treated_b vs treated_a contrast, with lfcThreshold rather than post-hoc filtering. Enrichment is preranked fgsea per contrast on the full tested list with a stated metric, explicit universe, size window, human collection with version, seed and mapping loss reported — well specified, if slightly beyond what the question strictly requires. The report names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, shared-versus-specific overlap, and the design caveats.
